policies.defaults: All four options off: case-sensitive, whitespace-sensitive, blank records eligible for first-occurrence retention, original order
policies.unicode: Native toLowerCase for comparison only; no full case folding, locale collation, accent stripping or Unicode normalization
policies.sort: Post-deduplication UTF-16 lexicographic comparison keys; original index breaks ties; retained text unchanged
policies.lines: LF/CRLF/CR; empty input zero, trailing separator another record; output LF; counts refer to retained records, including one empty record yielding empty output
policies.limit: 100,000 UTF-16 units. No maxlength truncation; oversized original retained and current results invalidated. Set lookup; optional sort.

limitations: Only recorded Edge engine executed; physical-device and screen-reader compatibility not certified
Clipboard success/denial/missing API are simulated; UTF-8 download Blob is captured in memory, not an OS save-dialog test
Composition events are simulated, not native IME certification
Performance checks use actual exact full-limit fixtures and one-second Node VM call guards on this host, not universal timing guarantees
Native lowercase and UTF-16 sort are deliberately not full Unicode case folding or locale-aware alphabetical collation
implementation_checkpoint: Real local source commit created before recording its revision as evidence. Final TESTED metadata and homepage integration follow separately; no publication claim.
initial_test_findings: Early fixture errors (special selectors incorrectly prefixed with # and an invalid-array fixture defaulted to {}) were corrected and all cases rerun. No shared test or quality gate was weakened. One all-suite run with concurrent browser workers hit CDP control timeouts (79 passed, 12 browser-hook failures); the unchanged complete 91-test suite passed sequentially in 33.85 seconds. Standalone new-tool suites also passed. This is recorded as a local browser-test scheduling limitation; no timeout or assertion was weakened.
